notes.title: Sekira Demo has been published!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I just published a demo version of Sekira on Steam. The game will be released this summer. Now you can try the demo and add the game to your wishlist (I hope so, haha)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3392230/Sekira/

notes.title: My Devil's Voice - Release!
notes.content:
Wohoo! There is new release! My Devil's Voice is available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639300/My_devils_voice_MLA/

notes.title: Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We are sorry for the inconvenience. On the first day, some of you might get not the most pleasant experience of the game due to some technical problems...

We have fixed most of the bugs found, including achievements. You don't have to play whole game again. Just go to main menu.

In addition, due to numerous requests, we decided to prepare a free DLС with a new scene with the main character's sister :) I can't name a date, because I don't want to break our promises, but we will definitely add it.

notes.title: Hope you're ready. February 23.
notes.content: We have decided on the date and it will be February 23, that is, tomorrow.

notes.title: Hooray!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We apologize for the fact that the release date was postponed for such a long, indefined period :(( By adding the DLC to the game before publishing the base game, we triggered having the DLC (and thus the whole game) checked by Steam moderators, which took a long time, holding up the release. But, finally, this procedure is completed and the game can be published.

[b] The release will take place early next week. [/b]
